reason: SignalR hub route. Has real IAuthorizeData ("AdminOrAbove") but cannot be probed with a plain GET/POST the way REST routes are: SignalR's own protocol negotiation runs before ASP.NET Core authorization fully resolves, so an authenticated non-anonymous request without a completed negotiate handshake returns a raw "Connection ID required" 400 text body (verified live, not the ApiResponse auth-challenge envelope), not a distinguishable 401/403 authorization failure. Probing negotiate directly requires a full SignalR client handshake, which is out of scope for a generic authz-gate matrix (Ruling D).
